templates.name: Roadmap by outcome, left panel narrative
templates.purpose: A left panel explains the sequencing logic; three horizon rows each name the patient problem to solve, how it is measured and what ships.

body.text: Patients give up at the front door before they reach care.
Fix booking first, extend care between visits next, then widen who the app reaches.
Each horizon names the problem, not the feature list.
Patients give up on booking before they reach a visit
Measure: bookings completed without a call
Patients lose the thread between visits
Measure: care-plan tasks completed in the app
Ships: care plans, remote monitoring pilot, cost estimates
Families and caregivers are locked out of the app
Measure: share of patients with a proxy or language preference
